abstract: Although multimodal recommendations have shown the ability to learn user preferences and item properties by leveraging explicit multimodal information, they remain constrained by two critical limitations: low-quality representation learning and modality fusion. For the former, existing solutions primarily focus on multi-granularity representation learning; however, we argue that training such representations is difficult due to the inherent data sparsity problem in recommendation scenarios. For the latter, existing solutions often rely on contrastive learning to align representations of different modalities to facilitate modality fusion, yet alignment-only objectives may over-compress valuable modality-specific information. To this end, we suggest \underline{``Take a Step Back"} and propose a \textbf{D}ual-granularity raw feature empowered \textbf{I}ntermediate fusion \textbf{G}raph \textbf{C}onvolutional \textbf{N}etwork (\textbf{DIGCN}) for multimodal recommendation. DIGCN leverages the multimodal understanding capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to construct dual-granularity raw features directly. Furthermore, DIGCN introduces an intermediate fusion graph convolutional network equipped with dynamic cross-modality weight correction, designed to capture cross-modality signals and achieve effective modality fusion. Comprehensive experiments on four real-world datasets validate that DIGCN consistently outperforms a variety of strong baselines. Additional analyses confirm its superiority under varying levels of data sparsity and cold-start scenarios. Notably, DIGCN demonstrates high extensibility, capable of further benefiting from additional contrastive learning-based alignment tasks.
key_ideas:
🔸 用GPT-4o与DALL-E-3等模型对原始文本和图像生成粗粒度版本，与原特征构成双粒度分支，行为模态ID共享初始嵌入并维持分支锚点状态。
🔸 中间融合GCN以ID为锚点，每层先计算临时锚点与各模态传播表示，再用基于余弦相似度的动态校验权重（范围[0,2]）加权融合，分母归一化防止单一模态主导。
🔸 逐层传播后通过Readout（取均值）获得各粒度表示，再用可学习权重σ(α)聚合细/粗粒度最终表示。
🔸 基于原始特征相似度预构建统一的item-item图（训练中冻结），仅保留top-k邻居做一跳聚合，并以残差方式保留物品个性。
🔸 采用BPR损失优化，框架可插拔式叠加模态对齐、粒度对齐或两者组合的InfoNCE辅助任务。
analysis_summary:
🔸 在Baby、Sports、Pet、Office四个Amazon数据集上全面超越15个基线，相对最强基线MambaRec的Recall@20提升分别为3.54%、5.17%、8.81%、6.49%，均具统计显著性。
🔸 消融实验表明双粒度特征、中间融合GCN、item-item图和动态权重均有贡献，均匀权重变体证明动态校正超出融合结构本身的价值。
🔸 数据稀疏分组分析和物品冷启动实验（如Baby上R@20达0.0633）中均领先，最稀疏用户组收益最大；中间融合几乎不增加计算开销，训练时间与显存具竞争力（Baby上2.99秒/轮、2.40GB）。
🔸 LLM敏感性实验涵盖10种文本-图像生成器组合，均值差异小且标准差低，开源组合也具竞争力；多粒度扩展（3、4粒度）仅带来边际收益且方差增大。
🔸 生成信息控制实验显示仅用生成特征（-C）会降低性能，说明收益来自双粒度组合而非生成内容本身；局限在于依赖LLM离线预处理，且生成内容可能继承偏差。
personal_view: 基于全文来看，这篇文章的核心创新在于'退一步'的思路重构：将多粒度学习从训练阶段前移到特征构造阶段，用LLM离线生成粗粒度特征规避稀疏监督难题；融合策略上以ID为锚点做逐层中间融合，设计合理且几乎不增加开销。实验覆盖面扎实，LLM敏感性、生成信息控制和多粒度扩展等分析有效排除了'收益来自生成内容'的替代解释，增强说服力。实用价值方面，离线生成可复用、框架简洁高效，利于落地。局限在于效果依赖生成模型质量，可能引入生成偏差需事实校验，且实验限于Amazon数据集，跨域泛化尚待验证。
